articles.title: Atlas-3 language model released, tops industry benchmarks
articles.description: The new Atlas-3 model sets records across reasoning and coding benchmarks.
articles.content: The Atlas-3 language model launched today, with the lab claiming the model tops major reasoning and coding benchmarks. Researchers say the model release marks a step change for AI assistants.

articles.title: Nations reach climate finance deal at summit
articles.description: Negotiators agreed a climate finance package after late-night talks.
articles.content: Nations reached a climate finance deal at the summit, pledging funds to help developing countries adapt. Climate groups called the finance agreement a start but warned more is needed.

articles.title: Mars sample-return mission gets green light
articles.description: The agency approved the long-delayed Mars sample return mission.
articles.content: The Mars sample return mission received approval, clearing the way to bring Mars rock samples back to Earth. The Mars mission has faced budget and schedule pressure for years.

articles.title: Regulators weigh new rules for frontier AI models
articles.description: Lawmakers debate oversight for the most capable AI models.
articles.content: Regulators are weighing rules for frontier AI models, focusing on safety testing and transparency. The proposed AI regulation would require labs to disclose model evaluations.

articles.title: Fusion startup hits net-energy milestone
articles.description: A private fusion company reports a net-energy result.
articles.content: A fusion startup hit a net-energy milestone, saying its reactor produced more energy than it consumed. The fusion result, if confirmed, would be a milestone for clean energy.

articles.title: Major breach exposes millions of records
articles.description: A large data breach has exposed millions of user records.
articles.content: A major breach exposed millions of records, security researchers said. The breach included emails and hashed passwords; users are urged to reset credentials.

articles.title: Quantum chip demonstrates error correction at scale
articles.description: Researchers show quantum error correction on a larger chip.
articles.content: A quantum chip demonstrated error correction at scale, a key step toward useful quantum computing. The quantum result reduces error rates as more qubits are added.

articles.title: Humanoid robots enter warehouse trials
articles.description: Humanoid robots begin real-world warehouse trials.
articles.content: Humanoid robots entered warehouse trials this week, handling picking and sorting tasks. The robots are being tested alongside human workers in live facilities.
